name: Bramblekeep
short_desc: Self-hosted single-binary workspace: pages, databases and sharing.
description: Bramblekeep is a unified, self-hosted workspace and a free, open-source alternative to the proprietary all-in-one tools (Notion, Coda, Confluence, ClickUp) without the vendor lock-in. Rich pages over a CRDT for real-time collaboration, databases with fourteen column types and six views (table, board, calendar, gallery, chart, graph), relations, rollups and formulas, per-page sharing with public token links, and built-in documentation shipped inside the binary. Zero telemetry and no outbound network call unless you ask for one. Your whole installation is a single SQLite database plus an uploads folder that you own.
author: MerryPatch

form_fields.label: Setup code (optional)
form_fields.hint: Whoever opens the app first creates the owner account. Set a secret here to require it on that screen, useful if the app is reachable before you sign up. Inert once the owner exists.

form_fields.label: Secure session cookie
form_fields.hint: Enable when you expose the app over HTTPS (a Tipi domain or a local subdomain). Leave off for plain http access by IP, otherwise the browser drops the session cookie and you cannot sign in.

form_fields.label: SMTP host (optional)
form_fields.hint: Only needed to email magic links and invitations. Without it, password sign-in works and login links are printed to the container logs.

form_fields.label: Unsplash access key (optional)
form_fields.hint: Enables the cover-image picker. Public Access Key from https://unsplash.com/oauth/applications, not the Secret Key. Can also be set later in Settings by an admin.
